dmn_experiences.title: York Craft Beer Tasting Experience - York Brewery Tours (Private Groups)
dmn_experiences.summary: A private-group guided walking tour of three York city-centre craft beer venues with tastings and an expert guide.
highlights: Visit three specially selected York beer venues
Sample a range of styles from pale ales to IPAs and stouts
Learn about beer tasting, ingredients and York's brewing heritage
Private groups of up to 20 with flexible start times
